According to the tracker, Trump's approval rating remains above water in Alabama, Arkansas, Idaho, Kansas, North Dakota, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Utah, West Virginia and Wyoming. All backed Trump in the last three presidential elections.

Wyoming remains Trump's strongest state, where his net approval rating stands at +16%. At the other end of the spectrum, neighboring Montana appears evenly split, with 46% of voters approving and 46% disapproving of the president's job performance.
